---
name: Online bug reproduction
about: Report a repeatable desync or lag problem
---

## Setup
Game version, emulator version, lobby server, player count, host/client roles, and enabled patches.

## Reproduction
Level and exact actions. Include frequency and what each client observes.

## Comparison
Does it happen with patches disabled? What changed between runs?

## Evidence
Share relevant diagnostics with private details removed. Do not attach disc images, BIOS files, game executables, assets, or raw decompilation.
